messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Severity=sev2 — sudden spike in cross-region 5xxs: ~12% of requests from eu-west routed to us-east failing with 502/503. Alert source: geo-routing-policy-eval (anomaly threshold). Pager: https://pd.example/INC12345

maria (oncall): seeing it. jumped from ~0.4% to 12% in last 2m. oncall taking.

maria (oncall): quick context — we rolled geo-steer v2 to 30% yesterday morning, should be backfilled but not full rollout. any config pushes in last hour? @deploy-bot, any recent geo rule deploys?

deploy-bot: Deploy event: geo-steer-v2 rollout started 2026-03-15T08:10Z by kevin; current canary=30%. No explicit rollback.

raj (netops): I'm seeing inconsistent DNS A records from eu-west resolvers — different edge IP sets returned based on resolver. Looks like some DNS nodes are serving stale zone data for region pins.

kevin (eng-runtime): hmm, geo-steer v2 includes a fallback that rewrites region pin TTL to 60s for quick convergence. If some DNS shards didn't pick up the new nsupdate, clients might read mismatched pins and route wrong.

maria (oncall): customer impact? Sara, any support tickets?

sara (support): multiple customers reporting elevated error rates and latency; top impacted tenants: beta-tier apps and a handful of enterprise customers in EU. Logged support P1s for 3 customers.

alice (customer-sre): confirming — our EU-facing endpoints to eu-west endpoints saw 25% increase in 5xx, customers observed retries fail. They escalated to account team.

maria (oncall): immediate mitigation plan: 1) pause geo-steer-v2 rollout 2) revert region-pin TTL to previous stable config 3) flush DNS shards serving stale zones / force zone reload 4) mitigate customer routing by temporarily pinning heavy customers to eu-west.

kevin (eng-runtime): executing rollback now:
```
rtrctl rollback --policy geo-steer-v2 --to stable-2026-03-14
```

kevin (eng-runtime): rollback triggered, watch for config propagation. ETA ~30s-2m for control plane to push.

raj (netops): starting zone reload on eu-west DNS tier1 nodes:
```
ssh dns-eu-01
sudo rndc reload example.com
# repeat for dns-eu-0{2,3}
```

raj (netops): rndc reload done on dns-eu-01/02/03, forcing SOA serial bump and zone push. Also invalidating CDN resolver caches via purge API.

maria (oncall): adding short-term route pins for top 5 impacted customers. kevin, can you apply per-tenant static pin override?

kevin (eng-runtime): applying overrides for tenants: tenant-123, tenant-456, tenant-789, tenant-1011, tenant-2022
```
routectl set-pin --tenant tenant-123 --region eu-west --expires 15m
```

kevin (eng-runtime): overrides applied. Confirming syslogs show pinned routes for those tenant ids.

maria (oncall): monitoring metrics. anyone seeing 5xx tail decrease?

incident-bot: Metric update: cross-region 5xx rate dropped to 4.1% (was 12%) in last 60s. Latency for eu-west traffic trending back down.

sara (support): customer A reported partial recovery, errors dropping after ~2m. Customer B still seeing intermittent 502s.

raj (netops): after reload, DNS responses look consistent across eu-west resolvers. TTLs now at stable 300s (was briefly 60s override). I'm leaving a temporary monitoring check on DNS mismatch rate.

kevin (eng-runtime): control plane confirms rollback completed across all routing services. Geo-steer-v2 canary halted.

maria (oncall): great. next steps: 1) keep pins for 15m then re-evaluate 2) let team triage why some DNS shards missed nsupdate — raj to investigate 3) SRE postmortem runbook and blameless RCA.

maria (oncall): assigning follow-ups: raj (netops) — deep dive on zone propagation gap; kevin (eng-runtime) — test harness for rollout safety (add shard consistency checks); sara (support) — customer comms draft; alice (customer-sre) — coordinate with affected accounts.

raj (netops): preliminary finding — an automated reload job on dns-eu-03 failed due to transient permission error during yesterday's maintenance window. That instance missed the nsupdate and continued serving old SOA until reload. I'll surface logs and the failed job ID in the incident doc.

kevin (eng-runtime): adding additional gating: rollout controller will require confirmation that all DNS shard versions match before global percentage increase. I'll open a PR with tests.

maria (oncall): marking incident as mitigated. Creating incident ticket INC12345 with timeline and action items. If errors reappear we re-open pager.

incident-bot: Incident INC12345 marked mitigated at 2026-03-15T08:15:50Z by maria. Severity downgraded to sev3.

maria (oncall): handoff to raj for investigations and to kevin for rollout fixes. Oncall ETA for next check 15m. If anyone sees regression ping the channel. :white_check_mark:

kevin (eng-runtime): quick note for retro — add a canary gating check: sample DNS resolution from multiple global resolvers and fail rollout if mismatch_rate > 0.5%.

sara (support): I'll send customer comms template now, include root cause and the rollback mitigation details.

alice (customer-sre): thanks team — will keep account teams updated and close customer tickets as confirmed recovered.

maria (oncall): closing thread for active mitigation. We'll open a follow-up postmortem doc with timeline and actions. Thanks all. :clap:
